entries.name: Eläinsairaala Evidensia Tammisto
entries.duty: Emergency open 24/7, every day of the year. Emergency line is premium-rate (2.30 EUR/min + network charge); general/booking line 0300 484 663
entries.quote: Päivystys on auki vuoden jokaisena päivänä, kellon ympäri 24/7.

entries.name: Yliopistollinen eläinsairaala (University of Helsinki Veterinary Teaching Hospital), Pieneläinsairaala
entries.duty: Small-animal emergency (päivystys) by phone: weekdays 16:00-08:00, weekends and public holidays; covers Helsinki, Espoo, Kauniainen, Kirkkonummi. Booking 029 41 57201 Mon-Fri 08:00-15:30. Premium-rate emergency line.
entries.note: City of Helsinki page says 'Eläinsairaalan päivystys toimii vuorokauden ympäri' and gives the number and address; the hospital's own emergency page (https://www.helsinki.fi/fi/yliopistollinen-elainsairaala/paivystys) states small-animal emergency hours klo 16-08 weekdays plus weekends/holidays (no 24 h for every day), so emergency_24h is left false. Phone and address come from the hel.fi page only.

entries.name: Tampere region municipal small-animal veterinary emergency service (Papuvet Oy)
entries.duty: Weekdays 15:00-08:00 and all day on weekends and public holidays. Covers Tampere, Orivesi, Juupajoki, Kangasala, Pälkäne, Valkeakoski, Akaa, Urjala. Run by Papuvet from 1 Jan 2026.
entries.note: Not 24 h on weekdays. Page does not explicitly say emergency care is delivered at the Pispalan valtatie address.

entries.name: Southwest Finland joint pet emergency service (Papuvet, Raisio) - City of Turku page
entries.duty: Weekdays 16:00-08:00; weekends and holidays around the clock. Small-animal emergency by Papuvet for the region's municipalities.
entries.note: No phone on the page. Yle (2 Dec 2025, https://yle.fi/a/74-20196785) reports daytime urgent care for Turku may move to Salo from May 2026 and the evening/night contract is under court appeal; verify current arrangement.

entries.name: Helsingin yliopiston Saaren eläinklinikka - small-animal emergency, Hyvinkää area
entries.duty: After-hours emergency line for small animals in the Hyvinkää area since 2 Jan 2023; call before going, on-call vet is usually not on site. Premium-rate line. Daytime on weekdays 08:00-16:00 via the Hyvinkää city vet.
entries.note: Notice dated from 2023; may be outdated.

entries.name: Ruokavirasto - Kiireellinen eläinlääkärinapu (national guidance on municipal on-call vets)
entries.duty: Municipalities must provide urgent vet care for pets at all times, organised in regional on-call areas each with a central contact service; some private clinics also offer out-of-hours on-call. The page does not list rota numbers.
entries.note: Phone is the Finnish Food Authority switchboard, not an emergency line.

entries.name: Zoodiaken (small animals' clinic)
entries.duty: For accidents or sudden illness on weekday evenings after 17:00 and weekends, call the same number to get the on-duty veterinarian's contact. Published opening hours: Mon-Thu 9:00-10:00 (as listed; confirm with clinic).
entries.note: Visit Åland listing; phone on-call, not a staffed 24 h clinic.

entries.name: Seinäjoen Eläinsairaala
entries.duty: Daytime emergency service Mon-Sat 08:00-21:00, Sun 09:30-18:00 (not 24 h). Booking 0300 484 655.

entries.name: Lahden eläinlääkäriasema
entries.duty: Emergency care every day of the year, not 24 h. Page heading says Mon-Sat 08:00-20:00, Sun 08:00-16:00; elsewhere on the page 08:00-20:00 daily (inconsistent). General line 0300 484 652.
entries.note: Hours inconsistent on the page; confirm by phone.

entries.name: Eläinlääkärikeskus Kieppi
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00, Sat 09:00-17:00, Sun closed. No out-of-hours emergency stated; page points to Evidensia's 24-h hospitals.

entries.name: Eläinlääkäriasema Villimys
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 07:30-20:00, Sat 08:30-15:30, Sun closed.

entries.name: Lemmikkiklinikka MAi-VET
entries.duty: Mon 8-18, Tue 8-16, Wed 12-19, Thu-Fri 8-15, weekend closed.

entries.name: Eläinklinikka KarleVet
entries.duty: Weekday daytime hours only; weekend closed.

notes: 11 Evidensia 24-h animal hospitals (Vantaa, Espoo, Helsinki Mevet, Tampere, Raisio/Turku area, Oulu, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Kouvola, Pori, Hämeenlinna) each confirmed on own page plus Evidensia's 24-h list; their emergency numbers are premium-rate (0600). Duty rotas: Tampere (Papuvet), Southwest Finland/Raisio (Papuvet, turku.fi), Hyvinkää (Saari clinic), Ruokavirasto national guidance, Åland on-call. University of Helsinki Veterinary Teaching Hospital small animal emergency is listed with emergency_24h false because its own page gives 16-08 weekdays + weekends/holidays hours (hel.fi says 'vuorokauden ympäri'; conflicting, not claimed). Poison line: none. Myrkytystietokeskus (HUS, 0800 147 111 / 09 471 977, 24 h) page opened covers human poisonings only; no animal poison line found; Ruokavirasto page has no animal poison info. Unreachable/skipped: helsinki.fi pages for exact univ hospital emergency number (blank on page; number only via hel.fi), rovaniemi.fi eläinlääkäripäivystys (robots.txt disallowed; Lapland on-call is municipal vets), evidensia.fi/palvelut/paivystava-elainlaakari clinic list (JS-loaded), Papuvet's own site (not found via search), Mehiläinen/other chains, Oulu/Vaasa/Lahti/Kuopio municipal rota pages, ELL/sell.fi (no public duty map found). Not covered: Vaasa, Joensuu, Mikkeli, Kemi, Tornio, Lapland tourist-area clinics (Levi, Ylläs, Saariselkä), further Helsinki-area private clinics, Turku private clinics, Pet-Vet/Koira-Kissaklinikka Turku. Independent check 2026-11-03: all 11 Evidensia pages, 4 duty rota/guidance pages (Tampere, Turku/Raisio, Hyvinkaa, Ruokavirasto), Zoodiaken, Helsinki univ. hospital (hel.fi), Lahti and Seinajoki re-opened; names, phones, addresses and 24-h wording confirmed, no removals. Lahti hours corrected to the page's Mon-Sat 8-20 / Sun 8-16 heading (page inconsistent). Ruokavirasto page re-checked: no animal poison line.
